progress.acquisition.title: Data acquisition decision
progress.acquisition.subtitle: {count} exact, project-owned acquisition gate is visible before any data movement.
progress.acquisition.empty: No bounded data acquisition decision is registered to this project.
progress.acquisition.boundary: Inspection establishes readiness only; it does not move data or establish an experimental result.
progress.receipt.title: Downloaded source bytes
progress.receipt.subtitle: {count} exact acquisition receipt is verified; content access remains closed.
progress.receipt.empty: No download-only acquisition receipt is registered to this project.
progress.receipt.boundary: The exact bytes and hashes are verified. This is not content qualification, benchmark admission, or experimental evidence.
progress.receipt.next_gate: Next gate · approve bounded, format-aware content inspection.
progress.metadata_plan.title: Next scientific data gate
progress.metadata_plan.subtitle: {count} exact format-aware plan is ready for an explicit content-read decision.
progress.metadata_plan.empty: No project-level structured metadata plan is registered.
progress.metadata_plan.next.approve_exac: Next decision: approve this exact local structural read; links, projection, ingestion, models and experiments remain closed.
progress.metadata_plan.next.regenerate_p: Next action: regenerate the no-read plans against the current auditor before requesting approval.
progress.metadata_plan.boundary: The plan binds bytes, parser identity and safety ceilings. It has not opened or interpreted benchmark content.
progress.metadata_population.title: Complete benchmark population
progress.metadata_population.subtitle: {count} audited population is projected before any task is selected.
progress.metadata_population.empty: No complete benchmark metadata population is registered.
progress.metadata_population.next: Next decision: review every record against the frozen overlap, license, signal, environment, reproducibility and safety rules.
progress.metadata_population.boundary: No task was dropped or selected, and formal outcomes, installed models and compute inventory were not consulted.
progress.qualification.title: Acquired cohort qualification
progress.qualification.subtitle: {count} content-bound cohort qualification is visible after data movement.
progress.qualification.empty: No acquired task cohort has been qualified for scientific use.
progress.qualification.boundary: Content qualification defines valid scientific uses; it grants no ingestion, execution, provider-call, or GPU authority.
progress.benchmark_qualification.title: Executable benchmark qualification
progress.benchmark_qualification.subtitl: {count} benchmark scope is bound to exact task and compute evidence.
progress.benchmark_qualification.empty: No executable benchmark candidate has been qualified.
progress.benchmark_qualification.boundar: The registered 8×3090 host has 24 GB per device; it cannot satisfy the three published 48 GB single-device tasks.
Capacity fit does not establish task or experiment readiness.
progress.review_iteration.title: Reviewer-driven research iteration

progress.review_iteration.node_approval: Requires explicit owner approval before execution
progress.review_iteration.boundary: This graph coordinates the iteration but authorizes no API, GPU, download, external execution, or expert review.
progress.review_iteration.followup.title: Registered evidence response
The target title remains submission-blocked until complete positive H1/H2/H3 evidence; otherwise its claim must be narrowed by the author.
progress.review_iteration.activation.nex: Next bounded decision: review acquisition of {count} metadata files (at most {size}); this page grants no permission.
progress.dataset_package.title: Exact dataset package

progress.dataset_package.boundary: {hashes} content hashes remain pending. This card authorizes neither network preflight, download, ingestion, API use, GPU work, nor execution.

lifecycle.title: Idea → evidence → paper → review
lifecycle.subtitle: Each gate is derived from project-owned bytes; review is not inferred from a stage number.
lifecycle.no_official_authority: Pre-submission evidence only · no official conference decision authority
lifecycle.state.evidence: Executable evidence is the current frontier
lifecycle.state.paper: A paper exists; reviewer closure is pending
landscape.decision.hold: Do not freeze the main experiment yet
landscape.decision.candidate: A candidate experiment design is visible
landscape.decision.ready: The experiment design is ready to freeze
landscape.types.title: Contribution types, not one mixed list
landscape.types.subtitle: Paper type and experimental use are recorded independently.
landscape.type.method.description: Changes how an autonomous research system searches, learns, executes, or revises.
landscape.type.hybrid.description: Makes inseparable method and benchmark contributions in the same accepted paper.
landscape.type.benchmark.description: Contributes tasks, environments, rubrics, judges, or a capability study.
landscape.type.unclassified.description: This earlier artifact predates contribution-type separation; use the latest registered revision.
landscape.tracks.title: Two inputs to one matched experiment
landscape.tracks.subtitle: Systems are compared; benchmarks and judges measure them. Hybrid papers are decomposed and may inform both tracks.
landscape.track.systems.purpose: Accepted methods and the system portion of hybrid papers supply candidate research agents.
landscape.track.resources.purpose: Benchmarks, tasks, datasets, rubrics, and judges define what the systems are measured on.
landscape.track.protocol.purpose: A formal cell exists only after one unchanged-core system and one qualified evaluation package share task, model, budget, telemetry, and judging contracts.
landscape.lenses.title: What is actually measured
landscape.lenses.subtitle: Six estimands stay separate; paper fluency cannot stand in for execution.
landscape.matrix.title: Lifecycle coverage
landscape.matrix.subtitle: Methods, hybrids, and benchmarks stay in separate lanes; a dot marks stage coverage, not one persistent trajectory.
landscape.candidates.title: Comparison readiness
landscape.candidates.subtitle: Reference means understood; adaptation means integration work exists; formal requires a qualified matched run.
landscape.candidates.resources: Benchmarks and judges used to evaluate
landscape.gates.title: Can experiment planning proceed?
landscape.gates.subtitle: The map is sufficient to choose the next no-run work, but not to authorize or freeze formal cells.
landscape.questions: Resolve {count} choices before freezing the protocol
